title: gtm-cs 1:1 prep - Maya Singh / Aaron Li - 2026-03-16
content:
Context:
- 30-minute weekly 1:1 with Aaron (AE) -- focus on top accounts, renewals, and escalations.
- Goal: align on action items for ACME (renewal June), remove open blockers, and refine QBR deck draft.

Account snapshot - ACME Corp (Tier 1, EMEA):
- ARR: $420k ARR (annualized from Y1 consumption + committed reserve)
- Usage: ~2.8M tokens/day (steady), 95th percentile latency 220ms (reported by ops dashboard)
- Onboarding status: production inference on two services (chat + rerank).
- Current contract: renewal window opens 2026-05-15, decision SLA target: 2026-06-15.
- Risk signals: spike in error rate last week (2.1% -> 4.8%) tied to newly deployed model variant; CS JIRA-4521 open.

Wins to celebrate:
- ACME migrated reranker to latest quantized model -- 18% cost reduction on that route.
- Positive feedback from team on latency profile after autoscaling tune.

Primary objectives for this 1:1:
1) Status and unblock for ACME renewal (next steps, stakeholders).
2) Confirm technical owner alignment and timeframe to close JIRA-4521.
3) Agree on QBR slide owners + data needed from Product/Observability.
4) Quick sync on pipeline of other at-risk renewals (BetaHealth, RetailCo).

Key questions to ask Aaron:
- Who is the executive sponsor at ACME now? (previous sponsor left in Feb)
- What are the internal procurement timelines? Any new procurement/legal blockers?
- Has ACME signaled willingness to increase committed reserve if SLA/price tradeoff offered?
- Are there outstanding feature asks that would materially move the renewal?

Technical talking points / to confirm with CS/SRE:
- Root cause for error spike: ops traced to model-variant mismatch + KV cache eviction. Needs follow-up from infra team.
- Proposed mitigation: revert variant on non-critical routes + patch model selection routing; ask infra for an emergency patch ETA.
- Latency SLO: they expect 200ms p95; we are at 220ms p95 -- need to quantify roadmap to reach 200ms.

QBR prep checklist (what I need Aaron to own):
- Slide owner for "Performance & Reliability": Aaron to capture p95/p99 trends, incidents (by week), and mitigation timeline. (deliverable: draft slides by 2026-03-24)
- Slide owner for "Cost & Usage": Maya to supply token trends and granular routing cost; ask Finance for month-to-month delta. (data needed: cost per-route last 90 days)
- Exec summary / Ask slide: confirm target ask (renewal + optional 20% committed increase).

Risks / Escalations:
- If error rate not back to <1% by next week, ACME legal may delay signatures citing stability concerns.
- Procurement lead change increases negotiation cycles -- escalate to AE manager if procurement stalls >2 weeks.

Proposed action items to assign in this 1:1:
- Aaron: confirm current exec sponsor and procurement timeline; set up intro meeting with new sponsor by 2026-03-22. (owner: Aaron, due: 2026-03-22)
- Aaron + Maya: finalize QBR slide owners and outline by 2026-03-18. (owners: Aaron/Maya, due: 2026-03-18)
- Maya: Pull last 90 days token and cost per-route export from Redwood Console; deliver CSV to Aaron and Finance. (owner: Maya, due: 2026-03-17)
- Samir (SRE): provide root cause write-up for JIRA-4521 and ETA for fix; target 2026-03-19. (owner: Samir, due: 2026-03-19)
- Aaron: Prepare a short ask script for exec sponsor (value + risk mitigation) for review in next 1:1. (owner: Aaron, due: 2026-03-18)

Follow-up & notes template (post-1:1):
- Send a 1-paragraph recap + assigned action items to ACME stakeholders and internal team within 24h.
- Attach QBR draft and data export.
- If Samir's RCA indicates infra root cause, plan a customer-facing incident RCA within 3 business days.

Open items / parking lot:
- Discuss potential discount tiers and how Dedicated offering might play into renewal (longer term).
- Confirm whether ACME wants on-prem option in evaluation (they asked in Jan).

Notes to self:
- Be succinct in the meeting -- focus on exec sponsor + timeline first.
- Bring specific numbers on cost reduction from reranker quantization to use as negotiating leverage.
- If procurement timeline slips, escalate to AE manager (Priya Nair) after two missed checkpoints.

Recent links / refs:
- Internal QBR draft: https://confluence.redwood.com/display/CS/ACME-QBR-notes
- Incident ticket: JIRA-4521 (error spike analysis)
- Ops PR for rollback: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/321
summary_actions: Aaron: confirm exec sponsor and procurement timeline by 2026-03-22
Aaron+Maya: finalize QBR slide owners by 2026-03-18
Maya: export last 90 days token & cost per-route by 2026-03-17
Samir: RCA + fix ETA for JIRA-4521 by 2026-03-19
